forgetOwnClip: The clip "{name}" will be forgotten. A stream playing it over and over gets the incident "A clip going round" again.
forgetSlate: The slate "{name}" will be deleted with all its pictures. Streams showing it will no longer be told to show a slate.
lastPictureKeepsTheClip: This is the last picture of the slate "{name}". The slate itself stays: it is still known by its clip.
lastPictureTakesTheSlate: This is the last picture of the slate "{name}": the slate itself goes with it.
latinLettersDigitsDotHyphenAnd: Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.
leaveEmptyToKeepTheCurrent: Leave empty to keep the current one. Changing the password ends the user's sessions.
name: Name
ownClip: The channel's own clip — not a failure
pictureWillBeForgotten: This picture of the slate "{name}" will be deleted. A stream showing this very one will no longer be told to show the slate; the other pictures stay.
slatesLead: Pictures and clips an operator puts on air in place of a channel: "for technical reasons…". They are marked with "This is a slate" next to a picture on a stream's page or in an incident. A stream showing a marked picture gets the failure "Slate" at the first look. A slate that moves may have several frames: mark it again under the same name. A slate marked in an incident "A clip going round" is also remembered by the clip itself — the fingerprints of its coded frames — and is known with no decoding. In the same place "This is not a slate" marks clips a channel plays of its own accord: there are no incidents for those.
soThatYouCanTellLater: So that you can tell later which system uses it.
systemsThatUseTheTokenWill: Systems that use the token “{name}” will stop receiving data.
theRequestsAreDescribedInThe: The requests are described in the
theTokenIsShownOnlyOnce: The token is shown only once — save it now.
userWillNoLongerBeAble: User “{name}” will no longer be able to sign in.
